title: Electrostatic force magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) must be correctly calculated as 6.0 × 10⁻³ N.

title: Charge magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) must correctly give the charge on each sphere, expressed as 4√6 × 10⁻⁸ C or its numerical equivalent.

title: Midpoint field strength
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) must correctly state the electric field strength at the midpoint is 0 N/C.

title: Force equilibrium analysis
description: Important: The solution must apply force equilibrium (F_e = mg tanθ) to relate the electrostatic force to the geometry and weight.

title: Geometry for angle
description: Important: The solution must correctly determine the angle θ or its trigonometric functions from the given lengths L and d.

title: Coulomb's Law application
description: Important: The solution must apply Coulomb's Law (F = k q²/d²) to solve for the charge, noting the spheres are identical after contact.

title: Superposition principle
description: Important: For the midpoint field, the solution must apply the superposition principle, recognizing the fields from equal like charges cancel.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Penalize if the student incorrectly assigns a non-zero electric field at the midpoint or misrepresents its direction.

title: Unit consistency
description: Optional: The solution may demonstrate consistent use of SI units throughout the calculation.
